articles.summary: Flex LNG is an LNG shipping company with a fleet of thirteen modern LNG carriers on the water, all with the latest generation two-stroke propulsion (MEGI and X-DF). Flex LNG is listed on New York Stock Exchange and Oslo Stock Exchange under the ticker FLNG.
